versions.changelog: v1.0.0: medical device cybersecurity compliance playbook - US FDA (mandatory SBOM/vulnerability management/penetration testing or RTA since 2026), EU (MDR Annex I 17.2, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act 2027, RED), China NMPA (registration review guidance); practical SBOM construction (SPDX/CycloneDX), CVSS-style vulnerability grading and coordinated disclosure, cybersecurity system and documentation (ISO/IEC 81001-5-1, linkage with ISO 13485/62304, post-market monitoring); 5-command zero-dependency toolkit
